a: Payback period is months to recover CAC from contribution margin.
SaaS magic number estimates sales efficiency from ARR growth vs spend.
Rule of 40: growth rate + profit margin as a health heuristic.
Gross retention ignores expansion; net retention includes it.
Logo churn counts customers lost; revenue churn counts revenue lost.
Expansion MRR comes from upgrades and added seats.
Contraction MRR is revenue lost from downgrades.
Revenue cohorts show how customer groups monetize over time.
A value metric ties price to the value customers receive.
Positioning defines how you differ in the customer's mind.
